# Bug Report

Complete the sections that are relevant to the issue. You may remove optional sections that do not apply, but please keep enough information for the problem to be understood and reproduced.

> [!NOTE]
> Before submitting, please review [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ZeroTraceAPI/Vector-Click/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). Bug reports and feature requests do not require the pull-request Contribution agreement, but the guide explains reporting expectations, project scope, and how submissions are handled.

> [!CAUTION]
> Do not include private or sensitive information. Review screenshots, videos, error messages, diagnostics, and other attached files before submitting them.
>
> If this may be a security vulnerability, do not submit it as a public issue. Follow [Reporting a Vulnerability](https://github.com/ZeroTraceAPI/Vector-Click/blob/main/SECURITY.md#reporting-a-vulnerability) for private reporting instructions.

## Area

Which part of Vector Click has the issue?

Examples:

* Mouse or keyboard input
* Timing, repeat, or action behavior
* Target selection or compatibility
* Stop, Emergency Stop, cleanup, or hotkeys
* Interface, display scaling, or accessibility
* Portable settings or privacy behavior
* Other / Not sure

## Environment

* Operating system and version:
* System architecture:
* Compatibility layer / virtual machine, if applicable:
* Vector Click version / file name:
* Display resolution and scaling, if relevant:
* Vector Click running as administrator, if applicable: Yes / No / Not sure
* Target application running as administrator, if relevant: Yes / No / Not sure

Vector Click officially targets 64-bit Windows 10 and Windows 11. Reports from other operating systems or compatibility environments are still useful when the environment is identified clearly.

---

## Relevant Vector Click settings

List the settings related to the issue when applicable.

Examples:

* Mouse button or keyboard key
* Single, Double, Triple, Burst, or Hold
* Fixed interval or randomized interval
* Independent, Drifting, or Natural variation
* Down duration and Action spacing
* Current or fixed cursor position
* Input method and selected target mode
* Target recovery choice
* Allow background input
* Start / Stop and Emergency Stop hotkeys
* Safety Shield
* Hide Vector Click from screen capture
* Remember settings

For timing, targeting, or safety issues, use conservative settings and the shortest practical test run that reproduces the problem.

---

## Status, errors, diagnostics, or other useful information

Paste relevant Vector Click status text, diagnostics, operating-system error messages, or other useful information here.

Optional: If the diagnostic report still reflects the issue, use **About > Copy Diagnostic Report** and paste it here. Review it before submitting and remove anything you do not want to share.

---

## Screenshots or video

(Optional)

Attach screenshots or a short video showing the issue when useful. Remove or obscure private window titles, account information, personal files, and other sensitive content.

---

## Additional notes

Anything else that may help reproduce, explain, or understand the issue.
